blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Twenty business, labor, industry and civil society groups called on Saturday for stronger economic ties with China without compromising Philippine sovereignty as they backed the government’s push for sustained dialogue with Beijing. In a joint statement, the organizations welcomed Foreign Affairs Secretary Ma. Theresa Lazaro’s recent phone call with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi, describing the Department of Foreign Affairs’ (DFA) diplomatic approach as constructive and pragmatic. The groups said continued engagement with China was important to Philippine trade, exports, tourism and the welfare of overseas Filipino workers. “The Philippines must likewise pursue mutually beneficial economic opportunities through […]...
